name: Elowenra
summary: Quiet boutique retreat site in stone and forest green, with a condensed serif voice, inset rounded hero and dark panels, and arch, circle and swoosh-cut image masks.

fonts.pairing: tall condensed serif at 400 for headings and italic quotes, Inter for body, wide-tracked uppercase eyebrows and buttons

signature: page content inset 12px from the viewport so hero and dark panels read as huge rounded cards on stone
image masks that mix a tall arch, a circle and one corner swept into a 320px curve
numbered category cards with a hairline between index and uppercase label
pale sage dot after every button and link label
imagery: lush architectural retreats, linen bedrooms, slow tables, English countryside, cool green-blue grade
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 12px outer inset for panels, 40px content padding, 128px section padding, 3-column cards, 24 to 32px radius
